title: Members of Henry Allen's and the Excelsior band
summary: Asked to name Henry Allen's band members, he recalls the drummers including Yance and says Clay Giles was in a different band.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Who was in Henry Allen's band then? Did you know the fellows in Henry Allen's band?
They're putting it all night out.
We want you to speak for them. They can't speak for themselves, so you tell us who some of them were.

He had his brother. His brother used to be a beat snare drum. Used to have a fellow beat bass drum. They called him Yance. Well, you wouldn't know the name. Their name wouldn't... What's his name? They used to call him Yance. That's the kind of Creole name. He got plenty of people around him.
Was he there before Clay Giles was playing bass drum?
Oh, that's a different band altogether. That's an extensive band.
Oh, I thought Clay Giles played with Allen at one time.

Not that I know of. Not that I know of. He wasn't there. When I know John, he was playing with the Excelsior. And I was playing with the Excelsior. A fellow by the name of Yance was beatin' drum. Bass drum.
Does that mean anything? That name Yance? Does it have any meaning?

No, there isn't. You know all them Creole people, all them funny names. I just don't mean nothing. Not that I know of. I know his people. They had plenty of fellas out there. Old musicians, you see. They were... I was living in the country then. Mm-hmm. The time I'm telling you what, when they come out there. And when I come here, well, they had done this band.
